messages:
harper_csm: Polaris onboarding hit an unexpected cost blip during dataset migration. They want a short QBR appendix + immediate guardrails before renewal review next Wed.

reza_finops: Billing snapshot: 7d total $15,750 (baseline weekly ~$3,600). Peak day 2026-03-09 = $5,900. Main culprit: mixed calls to `/v1/embeddings` and `/v1/completions` during ingest, embeddings model 'embed-prod-v2' ~60%.

nina_engineer: Logs show parallel re-ingest + retries; client retried 4x after transient 503s. Batch size was 800; no idempotency token. Also noticed frequent repeated small prompts hitting completions route for metadata enrichment.

owen_prod: Ops note: two things to propose for QBR slide: (A) immediate safety credit + spend alert, (B) short-term throttle and idempotency, (C) mid-term dedicated embedding pool or reserved throughput, (D) guidance doc for safe re-ingest.

harper_csm: For customer messaging, we should offer a one-hour technical enablement + a one-time credit and show projected monthly options. Can someone draft numbers?

reza_finops: Quick estimates: 1-week safety credit = $4,000; 2-week = $8,000. Dedicated embedding node (NVIDIA L4 equiv) estimate = $9,750/mo. If we enable caching + rate limits, expect ~30-50% reduction in short term.

nina_engineer: Paste condensed runbook to include in appendix:
```
1) Immediately: enable alert polaris@cs for 24h_spend > $4k
2) Short-term: apply route throttle to embeddings = 3 rps, max_batch=256
3) Short-term: enable idempotency tokens on ingest-worker and add retry backoff
4) Mid-term: enable KV-prefix caching and dedupe pass before reembed
5) Ops fallback: when latency < 2s, route to quantized embed-prod-q8
6) Escalation: sustained >$6k/day for 48h -> propose dedicated pool
```

owen_prod: Also recommend a tiny customer-facing checklist for safe reindex: stop job -> confirm idempotency -> run dedupe -> resume with throttles. I'll draft this one-liner for the slide.

harper_csm: Action items:
- reza_finops: prepare credit + slide table (EOD)
- nina_engineer: push alert rule + route throttle (1pm)
- owen_prod: one-liner checklist + link to docs (by Tue)
- harper_csm: schedule 15m pre-QBR run-through with Polaris (tomorrow)

nina_engineer: I'll add alert rule: `alert: polaris_spend_24h; condition: sum(24h) > 4000; notify: cs-team, finops` and add a quieter suppression for automatic retries to reduce noise. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/polaris-ingest-guardrails

reza_finops: Slide table snippet for QBR appendix: `Safety credit (1wk) - $4,000; Dedicated node - $9,750/mo; Est. savings w/ fixes - ~40%`

harper_csm: Please cc renewals@redwood on the invite and include the SLA fallback phrasing. Who will join QBR from our side? nina + reza + owen + renewals rep.

qbr-bot: Summary created for thread 1772223333 - owners assigned: reza_finops (credit/slide), nina_engineer (alerts/throttle), owen_prod (checklist), harper_csm (customer sync). Next checkpoint 2026-03-24 18:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

harper_csm: Thanks team! Drop updates here. :raised_hands:
